title: Our Working Places & Community Helpers
description: Learn about the important working places in our community and the people who work there to help us every day.

places.name: Hospital & Health Clinic
places.description: A caring place where sick or injured people go to be treated, healed, and checked by doctors and nurses.
places.audio_text: Hospital. Doctors and nurses work in the hospital to help people heal, stay healthy, and feel better.
places.fun_fact: Hospitals are open 24 hours every day, even when you are asleep!

places.name: Fire Station
places.tools: Fire Truck, Water Hose, Ladder, Helmet, Protective Suit
places.description: The headquarters where brave firefighters keep their fire engines ready to rush and put out fires or rescue people and pets.
places.audio_text: Fire Station. Firefighters work here to protect our neighborhood from fires and help in emergencies.
places.fun_fact: Fire trucks carry powerful hoses that can spray thousands of liters of water in just one minute!

places.name: Police Station
places.tools: Police Car, Badge, Walkie-Talkie, High-Visibility Vest
places.description: The working place where police officers coordinate to keep our community safe, peaceful, and orderly.
places.audio_text: Police Station. Police officers work here to keep our roads and neighborhoods safe for everyone.
places.fun_fact: Police officers are friendly community helpers. If you are lost, always ask a police officer for help!

places.name: School & Classroom
places.description: A joyful working place where teachers inspire students, teach reading, math, science, art, and good manners.
places.audio_text: School. Teachers work at school to help children learn new ideas, make friends, and discover their talents.
places.fun_fact: Teachers prepare fun lessons and creative games so every student enjoys learning!

places.name: Library
places.description: A quiet and calm working place filled with thousands of books, stories, and knowledge for everyone to borrow.
places.audio_text: Library. Librarians work here to help people find exciting books and keep the library peaceful and organized.
places.fun_fact: Libraries let you borrow books for free to read at home with your family!

places.name: Post Office
places.tools: Mail Van, Stamps, Envelopes, Parcel Scales
places.description: The working place where letters, birthday cards, and packages are sorted and delivered to homes and businesses.
places.audio_text: Post Office. Postal workers sort and deliver friendly letters and packages across the world.
places.fun_fact: Before delivery vans, mail was sometimes carried by horses or homing pigeons!

places.name: Farm & Orchard
places.tools: Tractor, Plow, Watering Can, Seeds, Barn
places.description: An open green working place where farmers grow fresh vegetables, fruits, grains, and take care of farm animals.
places.audio_text: Farm. Farmers work hard in fields to grow healthy food like apples, carrots, rice, and wheat for us to eat.
places.fun_fact: Farms supply almost all the food you find on your breakfast table!

places.name: Bakery
places.tools: Oven, Rolling Pin, Flour, Mixing Bowls, Apron
places.description: A delicious-smelling working place where bakers make fresh bread, soft buns, biscuits, and celebration cakes.
places.audio_text: Bakery. Bakers wake up very early in the morning to bake warm bread and delicious cakes for our families.
places.fun_fact: Bread dough rises because friendly yeast creates tiny air bubbles in the dough!

places.name: Supermarket & Grocery Store
places.tools: Barcode Scanner, Cash Register, Shopping Carts, Shelves
places.description: A lively store where shopkeepers organize and sell fresh groceries, fruits, milk, and household goods.
places.audio_text: Supermarket. Cashiers and shopkeepers work here to scan items and help families buy daily supplies.
places.fun_fact: Supermarkets organize foods by categories so it is easy to find what you need!

places.name: Construction Site
places.tools: Crane, Cement Mixer, Hard Hat, Blueprint, Measuring Tape
places.description: An active working place where builders and engineers construct strong houses, bridges, roads, and tall towers.
places.audio_text: Construction Site. Builders and engineers wear hard hats to build safe houses, schools, and bridges.
places.fun_fact: Workers wear bright yellow or orange vests so everyone can see them clearly and stay safe!

places.name: Airport & Hangar
places.tools: Airplane, Runway, Radar, Headsets, Luggage Cart
places.description: The bustling working place where pilots, air traffic controllers, and flight crew help travelers fly safely across countries.
places.audio_text: Airport. Pilots and air traffic controllers work here to fly airplanes safely through the sky.
places.fun_fact: Airplanes have two pilots in the cockpit to double-check every safety control!

places.name: Science & Space Lab
places.tools: Microscope, Telescope, Test Tubes, Computers, Lab Coat
places.description: A curious working place where scientists explore nature, invent new technologies, and study stars in space.
places.audio_text: Science Lab. Scientists work with microscopes and computers to discover new cures and learn how our universe works.
places.fun_fact: Scientists often do dozens of experiments to find one amazing new discovery!

quizzes.question: Which working place has fire engines, ladders, and long water hoses?
quizzes.explanation: Firefighters keep fire engines and hoses at the Fire Station.

quizzes.question: Where does a doctor and nurse work to care for patients?
quizzes.explanation: Hospitals and clinics are where doctors and nurses provide healthcare.

quizzes.question: Where does a farmer drive a tractor and grow fresh crops?
quizzes.explanation: Farmers work on farms to grow vegetables, fruits, and grains.

quizzes.question: If you want to read quiet storybooks and borrow books for free, which working place should you visit?
quizzes.explanation: Librarians take care of books and help readers at the Library.

quizzes.question: Where does a pilot work to fly airplanes high in the sky?
quizzes.explanation: Pilots work at airports and fly airplanes between cities.
